key_insight: Perfumer combines an LLM agent, predictive models, and Quantum ESPRESSO to accelerate structural relaxation and electronic band prediction.
engineering_relevance: The framework automates natural-language-to-calculation workflows, reducing computational cost and manual setup for materials screening.
method: Pre-relax structures with Perfumer-relax, then refine them using Quantum ESPRESSO.
Predict 12 band energies at requested wavevectors using a periodic graph neural network and latent Hermitian spectral head.
Preserve reciprocal-lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without explicitly constructing a Hamiltonian.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 2.75× overall relaxation speedup; trained on 125,153 band structures, the band model achieved 0.157 eV median per-material MAE on 2,607 held-out-composition-family test materials and about 97 ms inference per material on two consumer CPU cores.
watch_item: The reported median band error may obscure difficult cases; validate accuracy for target materials before relying on predictions.
paper_title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
